entries.zh: 完好齐全、肢体无缺（存疑：汉字栏疑作“契/奏”，与西语词头义不合）
entries.en: whole, intact, of all the limbs (uncertain: doubtful Chinese column 契/奏, mismatched with the Spanish head)
entries.notes: 汉字栏有[疑:契/奏]且与 entero 义不合，官话对音栏异常，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 浑全：完整一体、整个（之物）
entries.en: an entire thing; whole and complete
entirely, completely; fully, perfectly

entries.zh: 老实：为人诚朴、无诈（之人）
entries.en: an honest, truthful man; plain and sincere
entries.notes: 西语缩写 vldo 未能展开，释义以汉字“老實”与原稿音写为据。

entries.zh: 朴实：为人朴直、不虚饰（之人）
entries.en: an upright, plain man; honest and straightforward
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:樸/扑]，音写 pô 支持“樸”，释义取朴实义。

entries.en: to bury; to be buried
to bury, inter
to lay the coffin in temporary rest awaiting burial; encoffinment rites
to bury, inter (a corpse)
to bury properly, lay to rest

entries.zh: 殯葬：殯殮与埋葬（丧葬之事）
entries.en: funeral rites and burial
to escort or follow a funeral procession; attend a burial

entries.zh: 收骷髏：拾骨——捡拾骸骨归葬（洗骨二次葬之俗）
entries.en: to collect the bones/skulls of the dead (secondary burial custom)
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:骷/枯]，官话对音栏混入“mort”字样，释义据汉字与西语词头 enterrar 推定。

entries.en: to move the corpse (removal of the body, reburial)

entries.zh: 葬棺柩：以棺柩殓而葬之
entries.en: to be buried in a coffin

entries.zh: 哀悼（存疑：据汉字“悼”；西语词头作 Entonces，栏义不对应）
entries.en: to mourn, lament (uncertain: per doubtful Chinese 悼; Spanish head reads Entonces, mismatched)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Entonces 与汉字[疑:悼/章]及音写 chûn 不对应，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: then; at this (that) present time
entries.notes: 闽南原稿音写多出音节，释义依汉字“許今時”与西语 entonces。

entries.en: then; at first, at the beginning

entries.zh: 当元初：正当太初、往古之时
entries.en: right at the very beginning; in ancient times
then; at that (very) moment
